answer: Harbor sponsor-decay bond: a new identity needs a harbor sponsor locking 70 credits, filed on the harbor registry. It tends a dune plot, filing a dune reading per epoch; an auditor checks it on the dune table, and a mismatch, reused serial, or rented-dune plot burns the bond. Reputation starts at 100, falls 10 per idle epoch to nadir 0, where the bond halves. A fake costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 cost 3,037,000 + 70,000 locked. Honest agents pay 40 once.
